subject: Entitlements cutover dry-run: coordination and action owners
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@loranlabs.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Chen <bob.chen@loranlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Entitlements cutover — request to run dry-run next week

Hi Vanessa + Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're preparing to cut over our entitlements (SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning + IP allowlist update + service-account mappings) for the Staging tenant. Before we flip anything in production we would like to run a dry-run where Redwood routes SSO requests to a test assertion and SCIM provisioning is exercised against our sandbox accounts.

Goals for the dry-run:
- Confirm SAML config and ACS/Entity ID mapping
- Verify SCIM create/update/deactivate flows for our service accounts and 3 test users
- Validate IP allowlist behaviour (we'll open a temporary CIDR for the test window)
- Confirm service-account name conventions and secrets rotation steps

Tentative window: Wed 2026-11-18 14:00–15:30 PT. Can you confirm availability and whether Redwood needs additional artifacts from our side (certs, metadata, network ACLs)?

Attachments: saml-metadata-llabs.xml (attached for reference), initial_user_list.csv (sample accounts)

Best,
Alice
Identity & Security Ops, Loran Labs
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@loranlabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Entitlements cutover — request to run dry-run next week

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear goals. Wed 11/18 14:00–15:30 PT works for our team. Quick checklist and ask below so we can run cleanly: 

1) Artifacts we need from Loran before Tue 11/17 17:00 PT:
   - SAML metadata XML (entityID, cert) — you attached, thanks; please confirm the cert fingerprint.
   - SCIM base URL + 2 sandbox credentials (API keys) for provisioning tests.
   - IP ranges you will open for the window (CIDR list).

2) Redwood owners and roles for the dry-run:
   - On-call run: Vanessa Ortiz (CS lead) — I will coordinate cutover steps and watch logs.
   - SCIM/Provisioning engineer: Jordan Blake (integrations).
   - Security review & service-account naming: Ben Carter (security).

3) Operational plan we will follow:
   - 14:00: validate SAML handshake using a single test user
   - 14:15: run SCIM create + update + deactivate flows for 3 test accounts
   - 14:35: rotate one service-account secret (simulated) and validate token rejection/refresh behavior
   - 14:55: exercise IP allowlist edge-case (request from outside CIDR)
   - 15:10: collect logs + postmortem notes; confirm go/no-go for production cutover

I'll prepare a dry-run checklist and share a short runbook (attachment) — attaching draft: saml-scim-ip-dryrun-checklist.xlsx.

Any constraints we should be aware of? Bob, if Loran wants Redwood to run in a shadow mode rather than change live assertions, say so and we'll adapt.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice@loranlabs.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Entitlements cutover — request to run dry-run next week

Couple of operational notes to add:
- Please confirm the three sandbox users are not linked to any production resources (we need clean test IDs).
- If Loran's SCIM endpoint enforces SCIM 2.0 schema variations, we may need to map externalId <-> userName; send an example payload if possible.
- For service-account rotation, we'll use the service-account-map.csv format attached — Ben, can you sign off on the naming convention (prod/stg prefixes) and the rotation windows?

Short replies are fine — the plan looks good.

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Alice Nguyen <alice@loranlabs.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Entitlements cutover — request to run dry-run next week

On Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 11:27 AM marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> Couple of operational notes to add:
> - Please confirm the three sandbox users are not linked to any production resources (we need clean test IDs).
> - If Loran's SCIM endpoint enforces SCIM 2.0 schema variations, we may need to map externalId <-> userName; send an example payload if possible.
> - For service-account rotation, we'll use the service-account-map.csv format attached — Ben, can you sign off on the naming convention (prod/stg prefixes) and the rotation windows?

Confirming from security:
- Naming convention looks safe (stg- prefix for sandbox). I recommend including tenant-id in service-account names to avoid collisions.
- Rotation: perform a staggered rotation (rotate stg accounts first, validate for 10m, then rotate prod if doing live — for dry-run we will simulate).
- IP allowlist: Redwood needs the exact CIDR(s) and the start/end timestamps. If Loran wants the test to include an outside-IP rejection, provide a test IP from your list and we will run the negative case.

I've attached a service-account-map.csv with a suggested mapping and the minimal policy constraints.

—Ben
Security Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@loranlabs.com>, Bob Chen <bob.chen@loranlabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Entitlements cutover — dry-run complete / postmortem link

Hi all — quick post-dry-run notes and owners:

Summary: Dry-run executed 14:00–15:20 PT. SAML handshake completed; SCIM create/update/deactivate flows succeeded for 3 test users; simulated service-account rotation validated token rejection/refresh path; IP allowlist negative test blocked as expected. No regressions seen in staged logs.

Open items and owners:
- Loran: confirm final production CIDRs and upload prod SAML metadata (owner: Alice) — due 2026-11-20 EOD.
- Redwood (Jordan): update provisioning mapping for externalId -> userName mismatch in Loran schema (PR ready, target 11/19).
- Redwood (Ben): provide final service-account naming + rotation steps to procurement/security docs (due 11/19).
- Postmortem doc (link): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/entitlements-cutover/postmortem-llabs-20261118

Attachments: dryrun-log-template.txt (logs captured during run)

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — recommend green-light for production cutover once Alice confirms prod CIDRs and metadata.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
